The '''MK.4''' was a model of heavy [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]] produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 75 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It contained a stronger [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] charge.<ref name="DC" />
